question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_needs AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_needed
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inv AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, p.purchased, inv.qty as avail_qty, loc.warehouse, loc.aisle, loc.position
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN locations loc ON inv.location_id = loc.id
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE loc.warehouse = 1
),
inv_ranked AS (
    SELECT i.*, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY i.purchased ASC, i.avail_qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inv i
    JOIN order_needs ON i.product_id = order_needs.product_id
),
inv_cumulative AS (
    SELECT ir.*,
           SUM(ir.avail_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.product_id ORDER BY ir.rn ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_avail
    FROM inv_ranked ir
),
pick AS (
    SELECT ic.*,
           order_needs.total_needed,
           CASE
               WHEN ic.cum_avail - ic.avail_qty >= order_needs.total_needed THEN 0
               WHEN ic.cum_avail <= order_needs.total_needed THEN ic.avail_qty
               ELSE order_needs.total_needed - (ic.cum_avail - ic.avail_qty)
           END as qty_to_pick
    FROM inv_cumulative ic
    JOIN order_needs ON ic.product_id = order_needs.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, qty_to_pick
FROM pick
WHERE qty_to_pick > 0
ORDER BY product_id, purchased, avail_qty
